description: Emoji picker popup used by the Notion editor in two variants: the Shared picker renders a search input, categorised emoji grid and an optional Remove button positioned relative to the nearest positioned ancestor; the UI variant is an absolutely-positioned popup driven by Visible/Top/Left coordinates.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Fired when the backdrop is clicked (close without action).

parameters.name: OnSelected
parameters.description: Shared variant: fired with the chosen emoji.

parameters.name: OnRemoved
parameters.description: Shared variant: fired when the optional Remove action is used.

parameters.name: ShowRemoveButton
parameters.description: Shared variant: shows the Remove action that raises OnRemoved.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: UI variant: whether the popup is shown.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: UI variant: vertical position of the popup in pixels.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: UI variant: horizontal position of the popup in pixels.

parameters.name: OnEmojiSelected
parameters.description: UI variant: fired with the chosen emoji.
